theme.en: AI Demand Redirects Capital and Strains Supply
theme.zh: AI需求重塑资本流向，供给压力持续

dek.en: TSMC plans $1 billion of investment in Anthropic and OpenAI, and Fractile raises $720 million for inference chips. Reported HBM4 yield gains and a dispute over China export curbs put production readiness and market access in focus.
dek.zh: 台积电计划向Anthropic和OpenAI投资10亿美元，Fractile则为推理芯片筹得7.2亿美元。HBM4良率提升的报道与对华出口管制争议，使量产能力和市场准入成为焦点。

title.en: AI & Accelerators
title.zh: AI与加速器

title.en: AMD Plans Venice-X for Late 2027 with Up to 5.3 GHz
title.zh: AMD计划于2027年下半年推出Venice-X，最高频率达5.3 GHz

summary.en: AMD's Venice-X CPUs are scheduled for the second half of 2027, with the family reaching up to 5.3 GHz. The lineup brings 3D V-Cache back to the data center after four years, giving cache-sensitive workloads another route to higher performance.
summary.zh: AMD的Venice-X CPU计划于2027年下半年推出，该系列最高频率达5.3 GHz。这将使3D V-Cache在时隔4年后重返数据中心，为对缓存容量敏感的工作负载提供提升性能的路径。

title.en: US Data-Center Power Demand Grows 10 Times as Fast as Grid Capacity
title.zh: 美国数据中心用电需求增速达电网容量增速的10倍

summary.en: US data-center power requirements are growing at 10 times the rate of grid capacity, The Register reports. Operators face longer connection waits and a growing need to secure their own electricity, making power delivery a constraint on when new compute capacity can enter service.
summary.zh: 据The Register报道，美国数据中心用电需求的增速达到电网容量增速的10倍。运营商面临更长的并网等待时间，并越来越需要自行解决电力供应，供电能力因此直接制约新增算力的投运时间。

title.en: GPU Shortages Support CoreWeave's Expansion
title.zh: GPU短缺支撑CoreWeave扩张

summary.en: The Next Platform reports that GPU shortages are supporting CoreWeave's expansion. Scarcity puts access to accelerator capacity at the center of competition among AI cloud providers.
summary.zh: The Next Platform报道称，GPU短缺正在支撑CoreWeave的业务扩张。供给紧张使加速器算力的获取能力成为AI云服务商竞争的核心因素。

title.en: Foundry & Manufacturing
title.zh: 晶圆代工与制造

title.en: TSMC Plans $1 Billion Investment in Anthropic and OpenAI
title.zh: 台积电计划向Anthropic和OpenAI投资10亿美元

summary.en: TSMC plans to invest $1 billion in Anthropic and OpenAI, according to Ars Technica. The investment ties the foundry's capital allocation more closely to AI model developers whose infrastructure demand drives advanced-chip orders.
summary.zh: 据Ars Technica报道，台积电计划向Anthropic和OpenAI投资10亿美元。这笔投资使台积电的资本配置与AI模型开发商联系得更加紧密，后者的基础设施需求正在拉动先进芯片订单。

title.en: Memory
title.zh: 存储

title.en: SK hynix's HBM4 Yield Reportedly Exceeds 70%
title.zh: 报道称SK hynix的HBM4良率超过70%

summary.en: Chosunbiz reports that SK hynix has pushed its HBM4 yield above 70%. Higher yields could improve saleable output from existing production effort and strengthen its position against Samsung and Micron as HBM4 competition develops.
summary.zh: Chosunbiz报道称，SK hynix已将HBM4良率提升至70%以上。良率提高有望在现有生产投入下增加合格产品产出，并在HBM4竞争中增强其相对三星和美光的地位。

title.en: Equipment & Materials
title.zh: 设备与材料

title.en: CEA-Leti Launches SubFAB Labs to Reduce Manufacturing Emissions
title.zh: CEA-Leti成立SubFAB Labs，推动半导体制造减排

summary.en: CEA-Leti has launched SubFAB Labs to work on reducing semiconductor-manufacturing emissions, Cleanroom Technology reports. The initiative gives equipment and manufacturing teams a research program focused on the environmental footprint of fab operations.
summary.zh: 据Cleanroom Technology报道，CEA-Leti已成立SubFAB Labs，开展半导体制造减排工作。该项目为设备与制造团队提供了聚焦晶圆厂运营环境足迹的研究平台。

title.en: Policy & Geopolitics
title.zh: 政策与地缘政治

title.en: Lutnick Reportedly Delays Further Curbs on Nvidia Chip Sales to China
title.zh: 报道称卢特尼克再次推迟收紧英伟达芯片对华销售限制

summary.en: Axios reports that Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick stalled additional restrictions on Nvidia chip sales to China following an Oval Office dispute. The reported delay leaves the timing of tighter controls uncertain for Nvidia and buyers planning access to its AI accelerators.
summary.zh: Axios报道称，美国商务部长Howard Lutnick在白宫椭圆形办公室的一场争议后，阻滞了进一步限制英伟达芯片对华销售的措施。这一延迟使管制收紧的时间仍不明朗，影响英伟达及买方对AI加速器供应的规划。

title.en: Earnings & Markets
title.zh: 业绩与市场

title.en: TSMC Shares Rise 3.37% After Record NT$586.9 Billion October Revenue
title.zh: 台积电10月营收创下5869亿新台币纪录，股价上涨3.37%

summary.en: TSMC shares rose 3.37% after the company reported record October revenue of NT$586.9 billion, according to Yahoo Finance Canada. The sales milestone strengthens the revenue backdrop for the foundry's investment plans.
summary.zh: 据Yahoo Finance Canada报道，台积电公布10月营收创下5869亿新台币的新高后，股价上涨3.37%。这一销售纪录为台积电的投资计划提供了更强的营收支撑。

title.en: Quantum Computing Inc. Reports $9.5 Million in Q3 Revenue
title.zh: Quantum Computing Inc.第三季度营收达950万美元

summary.en: Quantum Computing Inc. reports Q3 2026 revenue of $9.5 million, exceeding its revenue for the entire first half, according to Quantum Computing Report. The report links the result to the integration of acquired photonics and semiconductor operations, making their contribution important to assessing the quarter's growth.
summary.zh: 据Quantum Computing Report报道，Quantum Computing Inc.的2026年第三季度营收达到950万美元，超过整个上半年的营收总额。报道将这一业绩与收购所得光子及半导体业务的整合联系起来，评估这些业务的贡献因而成为理解当季增长的重点。

title.en: Challengers & New Silicon
title.zh: 新势力与新硅

title.en: Inference-Chip Developer Fractile Raises $720 Million
title.zh: 推理芯片开发商Fractile融资7.2亿美元

summary.en: Inference-chip developer Fractile has raised $720 million, SiliconANGLE reports. The round adds substantial capital for the hardware and software development needed to compete for AI inference deployments.
summary.zh: 据SiliconANGLE报道，推理芯片开发商Fractile已筹得7.2亿美元。这轮融资为其开展硬件与软件研发、争取AI推理部署提供了大规模资金支持。

title.en: SambaNova Adds GLM-5.3 to SambaCloud at Over 200 Tokens per Second
title.zh: SambaNova在SambaCloud上线GLM-5.3，报告速度超过200 tokens/s

summary.en: SambaNova has added GLM-5.3 to SambaCloud with a reported generation rate above 200 tokens per second, according to Unite.AI. Adding another named model expands the inference workloads available on SambaNova's hosted platform.
summary.zh: 据Unite.AI报道，SambaNova已在SambaCloud上线GLM-5.3，报告的生成速度超过每秒200个token。该模型的加入扩大了SambaNova托管平台可提供的推理工作负载范围。

theme.en: Inference Efficiency Hinges on Representation and Scheduling
theme.zh: 表示方式与调度决定推理效率

dek.en: This selection examines speculative and diffusion decoding, distributed attention, and device-aware model deployment. Quantization, visual document compression, and byte-level modeling explore how representation choices redistribute memory and processing costs.
dek.zh: 本次选文关注推测解码、扩散解码、分布式注意力以及面向具体设备的模型部署。量化、文档视觉压缩和字节级建模则探索表示方式如何重新分配内存与处理开销。

title.en: AI Research & Inference Systems
title.zh: AI研究与推理系统

title.en: REAL Loss Optimizes Expected Acceptance Length in Speculative Decoding
title.zh: REAL Loss直接优化推测解码的期望接受长度

summary.en: REAL derives a draft-model training objective that directly estimates expected acceptance length in speculative decoding, using path weights and Rao-Blackwellization. In a controlled comparison with a Qwen3.6-35B-A3B target and a Domino drafter, it improves acceptance length against WTV, VSD, DBLast, and a static LK baseline across nine task subsets and five seeds. Longer accepted blocks could reduce target-model passes per generated token.
summary.zh: REAL利用路径权重与Rao-Blackwell化，推导出直接估计推测解码期望接受长度的草稿模型训练目标。在采用Qwen3.6-35B-A3B目标模型和Domino草稿模型的受控比较中，它在9个任务子集、5个随机种子下取得了优于WTV、VSD、DBLast及静态LK基线的接受长度。每轮接受更多token，有望减少生成每个token所需的目标模型前向计算次数。

title.en: B3 Overlaps Block Denoising for Faster Diffusion Language Models
title.zh: B3通过重叠分块去噪加速扩散语言模型

papers.authors: Amir Mann, Jonathan Fhima, Shaked Brody, et al.

summary.en: B3 refines two adjacent token blocks within a shared forward pass and opens the next block adaptively in self-editing diffusion language models. Across 10 datasets, the authors report an 11.5–14.5% speedup with comparable generation quality. The method targets latency lost when a block waits for its slowest token and requires no additional training or hyperparameter tuning.
summary.zh: B3在自编辑扩散语言模型中，让两个相邻token块共享一次前向计算进行迭代细化，并自适应地启动下一个块。作者在10个数据集上报告，生成质量相当时可获得11.5%至14.5%的加速。该方法减少了一个块等待最慢token所造成的延迟，无需额外训练或超参数调优。

title.en: Decode Token Parallelism for Memory-Efficient Distributed LLM Attention
title.zh: Decode Token Parallelism实现内存高效的分布式LLM注意力

papers.authors: Susav Shrestha, Brad Settlemyer, Narasimha Reddy

summary.en: Decode Token Parallelism separates model-weight placement from attention ownership, distributing one model copy in layer blocks across nodes. Each active node runs projections and MLP work for the full batch within its NVLink domain, and every node computes attention for its own requests using local KV caches. This arrangement targets the memory-capacity and cross-node communication costs that constrain high-concurrency, long-context decoding.
summary.zh: Decode Token Parallelism将模型权重的放置与注意力计算的归属解耦，把单份模型按层块分布到多个节点。持有当前层块的节点在自身NVLink域内处理整个批次的投影与MLP计算，各节点则利用本地KV缓存为各自请求计算注意力。这种安排针对高并发、长上下文解码中的内存容量与跨节点通信开销。

title.en: EngineAgent Automates On-Device LLM Engine Enablement
title.zh: EngineAgent自动完成端侧LLM推理引擎适配

papers.authors: Zhengxiang Huang, Yujie Sun, Shengheng Chen, et al.

summary.en: EngineAgent automates support for new mobile LLMs by mapping dependencies across model conversion, graph construction, operators, and hardware backends. It prepares engine knowledge and backend-specific build and debugging workflows, then uses a builder and an auditor with device-side validation to coordinate implementation. The evaluation spans 12 tasks, three mobile LLMs, and four engine–backend pairs across CPUs, GPUs, and NPUs, focusing on the engineering work required for engine portability.
summary.zh: EngineAgent通过梳理模型转换、计算图构建、算子与硬件后端之间的依赖，自动完成移动端LLM的引擎适配。系统先整理引擎知识，预先验证后端的构建与调试流程，再通过构建者、审查者和设备端验证协调实现。评估覆盖12项任务、3个移动端LLM及涉及CPU、GPU和NPU的4组引擎—后端组合，聚焦引擎可移植性所需的工程工作。

title.en: Mobile AI Factory Builds Specialized Language Models for Mobile Devices
title.zh: Mobile AI Factory为移动设备构建专用语言模型

papers.authors: Evan Li, Krishna Deshpande, Wen Cheng, et al.

summary.en: Mobile AI Factory searches model sizes, fine-tuning settings, and quantization choices using measurements from the target phone. Across 10 tasks and four Android phones, the system combines an LLM orchestrator with rollback rules that reject accuracy regressions. On an entity-extraction task, its search uses about one nineteenth of the GPU time required to exhaustively train 27 variants, illustrating how hardware measurements can guide a smaller model-selection budget.
summary.zh: Mobile AI Factory利用目标手机的实测数据，搜索模型规模、微调设置与量化方案。该系统在10项任务和4款Android手机上接受评估，结合LLM编排器与回滚规则，撤销导致准确率下降的调整。在一项实体抽取任务中，其搜索所用GPU时间约为穷举训练27种模型变体的1/19，展示了硬件实测如何帮助压缩模型选择的计算预算。

title.en: Weight Precision and Option-Order Averaging Share a Fixed Inference Budget
title.zh: 固定推理预算下权衡权重精度与选项顺序平均

papers.authors: Mohammed Nayeem Khan, Logesh L, Aliyas Ahmad Misri

summary.en: Simulated round-to-nearest weight quantization on Qwen3-0.6B and Qwen3-1.7B finds no accuracy loss from six-bit weights in tests spanning four multiple-choice benchmarks. For the 0.6B model at four bits, averaging four cyclic answer-option orderings recovers 12.6 percentage points. The study exposes a tradeoff between weight storage and repeated inference passes, with 300 items per benchmark defining the evaluation scope.
summary.zh: 在Qwen3-0.6B和Qwen3-1.7B上进行的最近舍入权重量化模拟显示，覆盖4个多项选择基准的测试中，6 bit权重未带来准确率损失。对于采用4 bit权重的0.6B模型，对4种循环排列的选项顺序进行平均可恢复12.6个百分点。该研究揭示了权重存储与多次推理之间的预算权衡，评估范围为每个基准300道题。

title.en: OpticalRAG Compresses Retrieved Documents into Visual Tokens
title.zh: OpticalRAG将检索文档压缩为视觉token

papers.authors: Senhao Liu, Yuheng Zhang, Chunyu Wei, et al.

summary.en: OpticalRAG renders retrieved documents as page images, uses a frozen vision encoder, and compresses their visual representations into as few as 16 tokens injected into an LLM. Its shared projection connects text-query retrieval with the visual-token compressor. It targets the context-window pressure of long-document RAG by transferring document processing into a visual encoding and compression stage.
summary.zh: OpticalRAG将检索文档渲染成页面图像，经冻结的视觉编码器处理后，将视觉表示压缩为最少16个注入LLM的token。它通过共享投影连接文本查询检索与视觉token压缩器。该方法将文档处理转移到视觉编码和压缩阶段，以缓解长文档RAG的上下文窗口压力。

title.en: One Byte, One Token Converts a 27B Hybrid-Attention LLM
title.zh: One Byte, One Token将270亿参数混合注意力LLM转换为字节级模型

summary.en: One Byte, One Token converts Qwen3.8-27B from subword tokens to a pure byte-level model, shrinking its vocabulary from 248,320 entries to 384. The two-stage conversion uses 4.77 GB of supervised bytes and takes 178.6 hours on eight H200 GPUs. Changing the vocabulary and sequence representation shifts the costs of embedding tables, output projections, and sequence processing, giving hardware-aware deployment studies a concrete conversion recipe.
summary.zh: One Byte, One Token将Qwen3.8-27B从子词token模型转换为纯字节级模型，把词表从248320项缩减至384项。两阶段转换使用4.77 GB的受监督字节数据，在8张H200 GPU上耗时178.6小时。词表与序列表示的改变会重新分配嵌入表、输出投影及序列处理的开销，为面向硬件的部署研究提供具体转换方案。
